trials.rationale: Overall located rate is only 50% and the system rarely revises (mean revisions 0.8 with cap 1), suggesting it is waiting too long before abandoning a premise; lowering the trigger to 0.4 will prompt earlier reconsideration of the leading account.
trials.predicted: Increased likelihood of finding the subject in cases where the initial premise is wrong, potentially raising the located rate above 50%, but may also cause premature abandonment of good hypotheses, slightly reducing the top‑decile belief success.
